minutes.headline: Finance Committee rejected, on a tie, a resolution asking to hear of off-budget spending over $20,000 beforehand.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the town manager's updates, then informal budget-preview talks with the DPW director and the police chief. Most of the evening went to the draft procedures and goals resolution, where the off-budget spending paragraph was voted down by roll call and a member agreed to redraft it. The committee also planned the special town meeting timeline, a joint Chapter 70 session with the School Committee, and committee liaison assignments.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at the start; none.
Chair asked for public comment at the end; a member instead announced he would be late to fourth-Thursday meetings because of another board.

votes.motion: Adopt the Finance Committee procedures and goals resolution as presented, including the off-budget spending paragraph.
votes.outcome: failed 3-3 with 1 abstention on roll call

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of July 22 as amended.

budget_items.what_was_said: Proposals due next Tuesday, evaluated on non-price and price before award, related to an article voted at annual town meeting.
Bidding delayed due to high prices; the town will apply for a small bridge grant and hope prices fall.

budget_items.topic: Food pantry move to TC Pacios
budget_items.what_was_said: Operating cost impact (electricity, appliances) must be calculated; paid from a special revolving account with no appropriation for the building.
Town already received half of its first allocation; an additional county-allocation amount comes directly to the town. Funds must be obligated by end of 2024 and spent by end of 2026.
DPW director described carried-forward Chapter 90 funds, pavement management and debt exclusion balances available.
Director intends to request a tractor with boom-mounted rotary mower again in capital planning.
Raising the capital threshold lets small facilities projects be budgeted rather than capital; year-end unspent money could fund projects.
Chief wants to add a part-time clerical position and eventually a second lieutenant and administrator.
Chief described an opportunity to lease a motorcycle at a low rate, with training included.
New vests purchased this year on a five-year replacement cycle.
Chief hopes to use ARPA money or grants to put cameras in cruisers.
Free cash appropriated for an agricultural preservation restriction would be rescinded after the applicants withdrew, and reappropriated at special town meeting.
Select board is considering a senior discount program; the circuit breaker credit was mentioned and a comparison town budget item.
A member estimated legal costs for a past 40B case and suggested this one could cost more.
Sewer commission reported a budget surplus year to date and a first invoice for Leominster debt service.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee's procedures and goals resolution failed on a 3-3 roll call with one abstention, which defeated its paragraph on off-budget spending.
A member agreed to draft replacement language for the off-budget spending paragraph, to return on a future agenda.
The committee planned a public hearing on October 14 on its recommendations for the special town meeting warrant, with the town meeting set for November 16.
Members agreed to a joint session with the School Committee on November 3 for a Chapter 70 presentation by an MASC representative.
The town manager, DPW director and police chief briefed the committee on ARPA funds, road money, and police staffing and equipment.

why_it_matters: The resolution's off-budget spending paragraph would have had the committee hear of such spending beforehand, so until new language passes, nothing in the committee's own procedures asks for that notice.
The special town meeting warrant and the Chapter 70 session with the School Committee are where residents will see how state school aid and the fall's spending articles are framed before a vote.
watch_next: October 14 public hearing on Finance Committee recommendations for the special town meeting warrant; town meeting is set for November 16.
November 3 joint session with the School Committee on Chapter 70, and the redrafted off-budget spending language on a future agenda.
